mechanism: Prednisolone may increase ethinyl estradiol levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and altered hepatic metabolism, while ethinyl estradiol can increase prednisolone effects by enhancing corticosteroid-binding globulin.
action: Monitor for signs of estrogen excess (nausea, breast tenderness, headache) and corticosteroid effects; consider dose adjustment if clinically indicated, though combination is often used therapeutically.
